_how_to_use: Remote ad control for WiFi Remote. Edit this file on keepitil.com and every install applies it the next time the app launches - no app update needed. ad_url = popup ad link. ad_title / ad_body = popup text. banner_url / banner_text = bottom banner. ad_every = button presses between popups (minimum 5). Delete a field to use the app's built-in default.
